a261106p1.summary: Potential Sciences, a startup backed by the UK government, is betting that training AI models on computer-generated biochemical data …
a261106p1.title: Potential Sciences, an AI startup building large-scale chemical data sets, secured backing from the UK's Sovereign AI Fund, as part of an eight-figure raise (Joel Khalili/Wired)

a261106p10.title: Preliminary findings: the EU says TikTok violated the DSA by not preventing its recommendation algorithm from trapping users in harmful content "rabbit holes" (Alexander Martin/The Record)

a261106p11.summary: From CISA to AI and beyond, the new Democratic majority has many opportunities to scrutinize government programs and push new policies.
a261106p11.title: Experts say the new Democratic congressional majority will likely seek to rebuild CISA, prioritize AI security, revive local cyber grants, probe DOGE, and more (Eric Geller/Cybersecurity Dive)

a261106p12.summary: Within an hour of Microsoft's announcement of buyouts last week, employees rushed to an internal site to see whether they had been offered one.
a261106p12.title: Employees at Microsoft, long known for its stability, are grappling with its decision to offer buyouts to 60,000 people as its spending priorities shift to AI (Emmy Martin/New York Times)

a261106p13.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is considering expanding into the advanced memory chip manufacturing sector …
a261106p13.title: Sources: TSMC is considering expanding into manufacturing 3D DRAM at the request of Nvidia, its biggest customer, amid memory chip shortages due to the AI boom (Qianer Liu/The Information)

a261106p14.summary: Surprise! Fox Corp. has closed its acquisition of streaming platform Roku, a deal valued at $22 billion, well ahead of the expected 2027 date.
a261106p14.title: Fox closes its $22B Roku acquisition well ahead of the expected 2027 date; Anthony Wood joins Fox's board and will co-chair a new Tubi, Fox One, and Roku unit (Todd Spangler/Variety)

a261106p15.summary: Nvidia Corp. is in for tougher scrutiny from a new Democratic majority in Congress that's set to demand answers …
a261106p15.title: Democrats, with Elizabeth Warren a top contender to chair Senate Banking, are poised to step up oversight of Nvidia over chip exports and circular financing (Maggie Eastland/Bloomberg)

a261106p16.title: Researcher: *sshole, a decade-old OpenSSH flaw, lets attackers use a password of 256+ characters to log into passwordless accounts on some musl Linux systems (Lawrence Abrams/BleepingComputer)

a261106p17.summary: Federal prosecutors say the suspects posed as corporate executives and high-powered attorneys, using AI to convince employees to transfer millions of dollars.
a261106p17.title: The US DOJ indicts three foreign nationals for allegedly using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys at major international law firms in a $129M+ fraud scheme (Rebecca Cohen/NBC News)

a261106p18.summary: Microsoft Corp. is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing from Oracle Corp., part of a larger reassessment of billions of dollars in cloud partnerships.
a261106p18.title: Sources: Microsoft has been turning off rented computing capacity from Oracle after declining to renew a 2023 deal, because the hardware used older Nvidia chips (Brody Ford/Bloomberg)

a261106p19.summary: SpaceX's reliance on US government-funded contracts will continue to shrink, Elon Musk said, signaling a shift in focus away …
a261106p19.title: Elon Musk says US government contracts will account for under 10% of SpaceX's revenue this quarter, down from 16.6% last quarter and around 20% in 2025 (Bloomberg)

a261106p2.summary: TOKYO — Asian stock markets tied to the artificial intelligence boom plummeted on Friday morning following a tech sell-off …
a261106p2.title: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers; Taiwan's Taiex sees a record intraday point drop, Kospi falls 8.7%, and Nikkei 6.7% (Jada Nagumo/Nikkei Asia)

a261106p3.summary: China's largest flash memory chipmaker, Yangtze Memory Technologies Co (YMTC), plans to source as much as 70% of the equipment …
a261106p3.title: Sources: China's top memory maker YMTC plans to source up to 70% of equipment for its fourth chip factory locally, up from just over 50% for its third factory (Reuters)

a261106p4.summary: Insurance startup Kalepa said on Thursday it had raised $75 million at a $470 million valuation, as investors bet that AI solutions …
a261106p4.title: NY-based Kalepa, whose AI platform supports insurance underwriting, pricing, and portfolio management, raised a $75M Series B led by Updata at a $470M valuation (Manya Saini/Reuters)

a261106p5.title: Blockaid: the Binance hackers stole ~$2.5B, or 40% of the $6.3B haul, in one Ethereum transaction using wallet permissions that cost just $15 in network fees (Sidhartha Shukla/Bloomberg)

a261106p6.summary: A new crop of Democratic governors-elect campaigned on putting the brakes on artificial intelligence development.
a261106p6.title: Cleanview: ~40% of pending US data center capacity is planned to be built in states where newly elected governors have pledged to stop or pause construction (Bloomberg)

a261106p7.summary: Carmaker will wind down production of futuristic pick-up truck at its gigafactory in Texas
a261106p7.title: Elon Musk says Tesla plans to wind down production of the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory around mid-2027 "to make room for increased Cybercab production" (Kana Inagaki/Financial Times)

a261106p8.title: Sources: Nvidia is requiring Southeast Asian customers seeking Nvidia Cloud Partner status to enroll in a program that tracks the locations of their AI chips (Mackenzie Hawkins/Bloomberg)

a261106p9.summary: Democrats are laying the groundwork to investigate some of the country's largest companies, setting off a scramble among executives who courted the president.
a261106p9.title: Sources: Democrats are eyeing Apple, Meta, and Elon Musk-led companies as early congressional investigation targets, after winning House and Senate majorities (Pranshu Verma/Washington Post)
